title: Two containers of peels
body: Ravi filled two identical containers halfway with garden soil and added the same amount of fruit and vegetable peels to each, covering them with a thin layer of soil. He sprinkled water on container P every few days so that its soil stayed moist, and kept it in the shade at room temperature. For container Q, he first dried the soil completely in the sun and then never watered it. After three weeks, the peels in container P had mostly turned into a dark, crumbly material with an earthy smell. In container Q, the peels had dried and shrivelled but were still easy to recognise.

title: Balloons on bottles
body: Meera poured equal amounts of warm sugar solution into two bottles, X and Y. She added a spoonful of yeast only to bottle Y. She fixed a deflated balloon over the mouth of each bottle and kept both bottles together in a warm place. After about three hours, the balloon on bottle Y had swollen, while the balloon on bottle X looked unchanged. Meera then carefully removed the balloon from bottle Y without letting the gas escape and let the gas bubble through clear lime water, which turned milky.
